items.title: McDonalds Stock And 2 More Dividend Stocks
items.summary: AI related spending and hiring are helping drive solid US job creation, even as higher interest rates remain on the table. That mix of growth and rate pressure keeps reliable cash payouts in focus. Dividend payers that offer moderate 2% to 5% yields and are increasing their distributions can appeal to investors who want income without stretching for ultra high yields.
